name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Federated episodes no longer show 'Missing' in the UI. They were materialized as their base Jellyfin CLR types with Path null, so LocationType resolved to Virtual - and the web client paints a 'Missing' badge on any episode with Type == Episode && LocationType == Virtual. Federated items are now created under dedicated subclasses (FederatedEpisode, FederatedMovie, ...) that report LocationType = Remote. One-time rebuild of existing federated items (watch/playback progress on them is reset once).
